universe_return.description: Within the selected research Universe, equal-weight one-session adjusted Close return. This is not an official index.
universe_return.missing: Two positive finite Closes required; no valid members means missing.
universe_return.numeric: Historical Universe members; zero returns count in the breadth denominator.

universe_advancing_fraction.description: Within the selected research Universe, fraction of valid members with positive adjusted Close return. This is not an official index.
universe_advancing_fraction.missing: Two positive finite Closes required; no valid members means missing.
universe_advancing_fraction.numeric: Historical Universe members; zero returns count in the breadth denominator.

industry_return.description: Within the selected research Universe, restricted to the specified SW2021 L1 historical members: equal-weight one-session adjusted Close return. This is not an official index.
industry_return.missing: Two positive finite Closes required; no valid members means missing.
industry_return.numeric: Historical Universe members; zero returns count in the breadth denominator.

industry_advancing_fraction.description: Within the selected research Universe, restricted to the specified SW2021 L1 historical members: fraction of valid members with positive adjusted Close return. This is not an official index.
industry_advancing_fraction.missing: Two positive finite Closes required; no valid members means missing.
industry_advancing_fraction.numeric: Historical Universe members; zero returns count in the breadth denominator.

if_else.description: Choose compatible branches using comparisons >, >=, <, <=, ==, != and Boolean and/or/not. Boolean values cannot be used as numbers.
if_else.missing: Unknown condition produces missing; only the selected branch determines each value.
if_else.numeric: Both branches are validated and counted in dependencies and work.

abs.missing: Missing input produces a missing result.
abs.numeric: Returns the non-negative magnitude of each finite input.

log.description: Natural logarithm; non-positive inputs are missing.
log.missing: Missing or non-positive input produces a missing result.
log.numeric: Returns the natural logarithm of each positive finite input.

sign.description: Map a numeric value to -1, 0, or 1.
sign.missing: Missing input produces a missing result.
sign.numeric: Maps negative, zero, and positive finite values to -1, 0, and 1.

rank.description: Ascending cross-sectional rank within the selected Universe.
rank.missing: Missing and non-finite values stay missing and do not enter the denominator.
rank.numeric: Average ordinal ranks map to 0 through 1; ties share rank and one value is 0.5.

lag.description: Value from a prior Research Session.
lag.missing: Sessions without the requested history are missing.
lag.numeric: Returns the value exactly window Research Sessions earlier.

delta.description: Difference from a prior Research Session.
delta.missing: Missing current or lagged input produces a missing result.
delta.numeric: Subtracts the value window Research Sessions earlier.

pct_change.description: Fractional change from a prior Research Session.
pct_change.missing: Missing input or a zero lagged value produces a missing result.
pct_change.numeric: Returns current divided by lagged value minus one.

ts_mean.missing: Any missing value in the complete window produces a missing result.
ts_mean.numeric: Returns the arithmetic mean over the complete window.

ts_sum.missing: Any missing value in the complete window produces a missing result.
ts_sum.numeric: Returns the sum over the complete window.

ts_std.missing: Any missing value in the complete window produces a missing result.
ts_std.numeric: Returns population standard deviation over the complete window.

ts_min.missing: Any missing value in the complete window produces a missing result.
ts_min.numeric: Returns the minimum finite value over the complete window.

ts_max.missing: Any missing value in the complete window produces a missing result.
ts_max.numeric: Returns the maximum finite value over the complete window.

universe_return.description: 在所选研究股票池内，按历史成分股计算单个研究交易日的等权复权收盘收益率；不是官方指数。
universe_return.missing: 需要两个正且有限的收盘价；没有有效成分股时为缺失值。
universe_return.numeric: 使用股票池的历史成分股；零收益也计入市场宽度的分母。

universe_advancing_fraction.description: 在所选研究股票池内，复权收盘收益率为正的有效成分股占比；不是官方指数。
universe_advancing_fraction.missing: 需要两个正且有限的收盘价；没有有效成分股时为缺失值。
universe_advancing_fraction.numeric: 使用股票池的历史成分股；零收益也计入市场宽度的分母。

industry_return.description: 在所选研究股票池内，限定指定 SW2021 一级行业的历史成分股，计算单个研究交易日的等权复权收盘收益率；不是官方指数。
industry_return.missing: 需要两个正且有限的收盘价；没有有效成分股时为缺失值。
industry_return.numeric: 使用股票池的历史成分股；零收益也计入市场宽度的分母。

industry_advancing_fraction.description: 在所选研究股票池内，限定指定 SW2021 一级行业的历史成分股，计算复权收盘收益率为正的有效成分股占比；不是官方指数。
industry_advancing_fraction.missing: 需要两个正且有限的收盘价；没有有效成分股时为缺失值。
industry_advancing_fraction.numeric: 使用股票池的历史成分股；零收益也计入市场宽度的分母。

if_else.description: 使用比较符 >、>=、<、<=、==、!= 及布尔运算 and/or/not，在类型兼容的分支之间选择。布尔值不能作为数值使用。
if_else.missing: 条件未知时结果缺失；每个值只由选中的分支决定。
if_else.numeric: 两个分支均会进行验证，并计入依赖与工作量。

abs.numeric: 返回每个有限输入值的非负绝对值。

log.description: 自然对数；非正输入为缺失值。
log.missing: 输入缺失或不大于零时结果缺失。
log.numeric: 返回每个正且有限输入值的自然对数。

sign.numeric: 将负数、零和正数的有限值分别映射为 -1、0 和 1。

rank.description: 在所选股票池内进行横截面升序排名。
rank.missing: 缺失值和非有限值仍为缺失，不计入分母。
rank.numeric: 平均序数排名映射到 0 至 1；相同值共享排名，仅有一个值时为 0.5。

lag.description: 之前某个研究交易日的值。
lag.missing: 没有所需历史数据的交易日为缺失值。
lag.numeric: 返回恰好 window 个研究交易日之前的值。

delta.description: 相对于之前某个研究交易日的差值。
delta.missing: 当前值或滞后值缺失时结果缺失。
delta.numeric: 当前值减去 window 个研究交易日之前的值。

pct_change.description: 相对于之前某个研究交易日的变化比率。
pct_change.missing: 输入缺失或滞后值为零时结果缺失。
pct_change.numeric: 当前值除以滞后值，再减一。

ts_mean.description: 完整窗口的滚动平均值。
ts_mean.missing: 完整窗口中任一值缺失时结果缺失。
ts_mean.numeric: 返回完整窗口内的算术平均值。

ts_sum.missing: 完整窗口中任一值缺失时结果缺失。
ts_sum.numeric: 返回完整窗口内的总和。

ts_std.description: 完整窗口的总体标准差。
ts_std.missing: 完整窗口中任一值缺失时结果缺失。
ts_std.numeric: 返回完整窗口内的总体标准差。

ts_min.description: 完整窗口的滚动最小值。
ts_min.missing: 完整窗口中任一值缺失时结果缺失。
ts_min.numeric: 返回完整窗口内有限值的最小值。

ts_max.description: 完整窗口的滚动最大值。
ts_max.missing: 完整窗口中任一值缺失时结果缺失。
ts_max.numeric: 返回完整窗口内有限值的最大值。
